title: runstate's maintenance control-arm test fails on this host at base, proving nothing
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails in the full (non-short) runstate suite on this host, and I reproduced it at base with this tick's changes stashed, so it is not a regression from jlv. It is the same defect npq's try-1 already drafted (key 1d09d40493ed30479961076dbc343074530766229b1ff695cc688593219746d8); repeated here because the full-suite run on this attempt tripped over it again.
